definition: προ-γράφω  [in LXX: Dan LXX 3:3 cod., 1Ma.10:36 * ;] __1. to write before: Rom.15:4, Eph.3:3, Ju 4.  __2. to write in public, placard, proclaim (Dem., Plut., al.): Gal.3:1 (Lft., in l).  __3. = ζωγραφέω, to pourtray, depict: Ga, l.with (Syr. Pesh., Chrys.; Field, Notes, 189; CGT, in l).† (AS)
